content.title: Tiruchi District's Electorate Size Rises to 21.61 Lakh Voters
content.caption: The Tiruchi district's draft electoral roll shows a total of 21,61,238 voters, with 10,47,048 men, 11,13,872 women, and 318 third gender voters.
